intent: A short status word on a tinted surface, such as Beta, New, or Public beta.

tone: neutral (states a fact, not a state)

use_when: Flagging a short state or fact beside a heading or title: Beta, New.
dont_use_when: The word needs to do something — use Button; a Tag takes no onClick and no focus.

a11y.role: none (presentational <span>; a tag is text, not a control)
a11y.labelling: content is the visible word; sentence case, no all-caps unless asked.
